Subject: Re: Hollis Health — vendor banking & invoice workflow kickoff

Hi Sophie — welcome, and thanks for sending the packet. Quick answers and next steps from Redwood: 

1) Banking method: ACH is our preferred method for recurring US payments (faster, lower fees). We can also accept wires for one-off or expedited payments. For ACH please provide your routing/account numbers on the vendor form; we do not require an intermediary account in normal cases.

2) Payment terms: standard is Net 45 for newly onboarded vendors. We can discuss Net 30 after 90 days of on-time performance — Marcus, if you have a request for Net 30, please flag it and we'll route to finance.

3) Remittance: We require a remittance contact/email that will receive remittance advices. Preferred format is a single remittance email address (e.g., remits@hollishealth.com) or an SFTP/EDI endpoint for higher volume. If you want to send remittance files, we support CSV with columns: PO, invoice#, invoice_date, amount, apply_to_account.

4) Invoice submission + PO: Invoices must reference the Redwood PO number on the invoice header and be submitted to invoices@redwood-inference.com. We also accept uploads to our vendor portal (link below). Invoices without PO numbers may be delayed.

5) Vendor form: Please complete the Redwood vendor setup form here: https://redwood.app/vendor-setup/form/abcd-1234 — this captures banking info, remittance contact, and tax details. If you prefer DocuSign, we can send it that way.

Next steps (action items):
- Sophie: confirm remittance email and whether you'll use portal or email for invoices (due: Tue 5/12).
- Marcus: confirm whether you'd like Net 30 request (we'll escalate to finance if needed).
- Redwood (Rachel/Vivek): we'll create the initial vendor record after we receive the completed form and W-9.

Cc'ing finance and billing for visibility.

Thanks — I'll follow up with a PO once the vendor record is created.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Strategic Procurement | Redwood Inference
